title: Battle of Burkersdorf (1762)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Burkersdorf (1762)", at revision 1382485854, opens: "The Battle of Burkersdorf took place on 21 July 1762 during the Third Silesian War. A Prussian army of 23,000 men fought an Austrian army of around 20,000 men." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q697982, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1762 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
